# directus_panel (Resource)

Manages a Directus Insights panel within a dashboard (directus_panels).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard` (String) UUID of the dashboard this panel belongs to.
- `type` (String) Panel type id (e.g. label, metric, time_series).

### Optional

- `color` (String) Accent color (hex) for the panel.
- `height` (Number) Panel height in grid units.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name for the panel.
- `name` (String) Name of the panel.
- `note` (String) Description shown in the app.
- `options` (String) Panel-type-specific options as a JSON object.
- `position_x` (Number) Panel X position on the dashboard grid.
- `position_y` (Number) Panel Y position on the dashboard grid.
- `show_header` (Boolean) Whether to show the panel header.
- `width` (Number) Panel width in grid units.

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) Timestamp when the panel was created.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned panel UUID.
- `user_created` (String) UUID of the user who created the panel.
